```{r}
#| message: false
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(jsonlite)
```

```{r}
raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson", simplifyVector = FALSE)
length(raw$features)
```

```{r}
fire <- raw$features[[1]]
names(fire)

fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][[1]]
```

```{r}
features <- tibble(features = raw$features)
print(features)

features |> unnest_wider(features)

features |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
fires <- features |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
fires |>
  filter(str_detect(incident, "August")) |>
  nrow()

fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

ggplot(fires, aes(x = gis_acres)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  scale_x_log10()

fires |>
  group_by(fire_year) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fire_year, y = total_acres)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Acres Burned per Year",
    x = "Fire Year",
    y = "Total Acres Burned",
    caption = "Total reported GIS acres by fire year."
  )

fires |>
  group_by(state) |>
  summarize(total_acres = sum(gis_acres, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(total_acres)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  filter(gis_acres >= 100000)

big_fires <- big_fires |>
  mutate(
    lon = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1))
    }),
    lat = map_dbl(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      mean(map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2))
    })
  )
```

```{r}
big_fires |>
  count(agency) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(agency, n), y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Big Fires by Managing Agency",
    x = "Managing Agency",
    y = "Number of Big Fires"
  )
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10)

largest_fires <- largest_fires |>
  mutate(
    polygon_lng = map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 1)
    }),
    polygon_lat = map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      map_dbl(coordinates[[1]], 2)
    }),
    geometry = map2(polygon_lng, polygon_lat, \(longitude, latitude) {
      sf::st_polygon(list(cbind(longitude, latitude)))
    })
  )
largest_fires$geometry <- sf::st_sfc(largest_fires$geometry, crs = 4326)
largest_fires <- sf::st_as_sf(largest_fires)

map_bounds <- list(
  lng1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
  lat1 = min(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat)),
  lng2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lng)),
  lat2 = max(unlist(largest_fires$polygon_lat))
)

leaflet(largest_fires) |>
  addTiles() |>
  addPolygons(
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", incident, "</strong><br>",
      "Year: ", fire_year, "<br>",
      "Acres: ", format(gis_acres, big.mark = ",")
    )
  ) |>
  fitBounds(
    lng1 = map_bounds$lng1,
    lat1 = map_bounds$lat1,
    lng2 = map_bounds$lng2,
    lat2 = map_bounds$lat2
  )
```
